row.topic: Contraception priority cues and patient teaching

visualPlan.prompt: Create a clean nursing-student learning visual using a comparison table plus cue-to-teaching flow. Topic: Contraception priority cues and patient teaching. Audience: prelicensure nursing students. Show: Header -> Cue Cluster -> Interpretation -> Safe Action -> Common Trap. Style: simple instructional diagram, high contrast, plain labels, no stock-photo realism, no decorative clutter.

elements.label: Header
elements.content: Contraception: priority cues and safe nursing action
elements.purpose: Names the student task in learner language.

elements.label: Cue Cluster
elements.content: 3-5 signs, assessment findings, or patient statements that matter for Contraception priority cues and patient teaching.
elements.purpose: Helps the student recognize what data belongs together.

elements.label: Interpretation
elements.content: One short sentence explaining why the cue cluster matters for Physiological Integrity.
elements.purpose: Connects cues to clinical judgment instead of memorization.

elements.label: Safe Action
elements.content: One first nursing action and one patient-teaching point for Maternal-Newborn.
elements.purpose: Makes the visual useful in practice and NCLEX-style reasoning.

elements.label: Common Trap
elements.content: One misconception or distractor path to avoid.
elements.purpose: Supports quiz rationale and wrong-answer review.

accessibilityNotes: Alt text should summarize the decision path for Contraception, not describe decoration.
Use text labels in the graphic; do not rely on color alone.
Keep reading order: cue cluster, interpretation, safe action, common trap.
Use simple icons only when they reinforce the written label.
reviewQuestions: Is the clinical framing accurate enough for a first student-facing visual?
Does this visual clarify the lesson rather than decorate it?
Does the common trap match the existing quiz rationale?
Should this be approved for visual production, revised, or held?

liveMutation.reason: Local decision capture only. Live topic-production review must be performed deliberately after human approval.
